attchmntText: Syncom Formulations (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Syncom Formulations India Limited submitted its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on 13th November 2026. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 26131.67 lakhs, compared to Rs. 23798.20 lakhs in the previous year. Profit before tax stood at Rs. 6625.18 lakhs, up from Rs. 4257.45 lakhs. Profit for the period was Rs. 4998.47 lakhs, versus Rs. 3257.04 lakhs previously. Earnings per share for the half year was Rs. 0.53, compared to Rs. 0.35. The statutory auditors issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were found. The company is filing these results in XBRL format and will publish them in newspapers.
